description: Parameters of 4-states simplified Anderson-Fouad (SimpleAFMachine) model. The derivative of stator fluxes (ψd and ψq) is neglected and ωψd = ψd and ωψq = ψq is assumed (i.e. ω=1.0). This is standard when transmission network dynamics is neglected. If transmission dynamics is considered use the full order Anderson Fouad model

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component

Xd_p.description: Transient reactance after EMF in d-axis

Xq_p.description: Transient reactance after EMF in q-axis

Xd_pp.description: Sub-Transient reactance after EMF in d-axis

Xq_pp.description: Sub-Transient reactance after EMF in q-axis

Td0_p.description: Time constant of transient d-axis voltage Units: s.

Tq0_p.description: Time constant of transient q-axis voltage Units: s.

Td0_pp.description: Time constant of sub-transient d-axis voltage Units: s.

Tq0_pp.description: Time constant of sub-transient q-axis voltage Units: s.

title: SimpleAFMachine
